title: No endpoint reports the calling key's own scopes, so the wizard shows scopes as unknown
evidence: GET /keys (scope keys) lists the tenant's keys with scopes but does not mark the caller's key; no whoami route exists in apps/api/src. The wizard only shows which scoped reads it observed granted or 403.
fix_direction: A future authenticated GET that returns req.auth.scopes only (the caller's own) would let the scopes item be real; deliberately not added here (no privileged endpoint).

title: No endpoint reports the Google (gws) Calendar/Gmail connection, so the wizard shows it as unknown with the gws auth status command
evidence: apps/api/src/gws-calendar.ts and gws-gmail.ts shell out to gws; no route exposes connection status.
fix_direction: A booleans-only read endpoint wrapping gws auth status (exit code only), after a decision on running gws from a request handler.

title: GET /setup/status reports process-env presence, not that a configured key actually works
evidence: apps/api/src/activity-health/setup-status.ts reads GEMINI_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY and the three LANGFUSE_* variables for non-empty values only; a wrong key still shows Ready.
fix_direction: Out of scope: a live validity probe would spend provider quota; the item text says the key is 'set', not 'valid'.
